title: Software
unsupported: Software installation is not available on this system.

reason.end_of_life: Its upstream support has ended, so installing it must be confirmed first.
reason.not_built: No package is available for this system.

advanced.unofficialRepo: {repo} is not the official repository of {software}; it was reviewed and approved for this purpose.

statusUnavailable: The panel could not find out which software is installed, so no version is marked as installed.

confirmRemove.title: Uninstall {name} {line}?
confirmRemove.content: The packages of {name} {line} will be removed. Configuration files and data are kept.
confirmRemove.runtimeContent: The files of {name} {line} will be removed. A runtime has no configuration or data to keep; projects that use it will stop working until it is installed again.

install.probeFailed: The download sources could not be checked

policy.title: Download sources
policy.intro: Which sources installations may download prebuilt runtimes and system packages from. Every download is checked against the official checksum or signature.
policy.readOnly: Your role can view this setting but not change it.

recommended.description: The fastest source that serves exactly the official files: official addresses, the upstream's official mirrors, a few approved mirrors and the source the server already uses.

official.description: Only the upstream's own addresses and mirror sites.

probe.skipped: {count} more mirror not compared (slower to answer) | {count} more mirrors not compared (slower to answer)
probe.systemNote: The system's sources can be switched on the System page.
probe.thisInstallOnly: Used for this installation only; the server's package sources are not changed.

warning.in_use_behind: The source in use is {duration} behind the official one, so this installation may not get the newest packages.
warning.in_use_unusable: The source in use did not answer or does not have the package index.
warning.official_unreachable: The official source could not be reached, so the mirrors could not be compared with it. Downloads are still checked against the official checksum.
warning.no_eligible: No source serves the official file.

estimate.partial: Lines from repositories that are not added yet are not included.

empty.title: No software here
empty.installedText: Install software from the All tab; it then shows here with its services.

eol.distribution: Maintained by the distribution (upstream support ended on {date})

endOfLife.openLine: {name} {line}, {state}, upstream support has ended: open its settings
endOfLife.installed: Upstream support for {name} {line} ended on {date}: it no longer gets security updates. Move the sites and data that use it to a supported version, then uninstall it.
endOfLife.notInstalled: Upstream support for {name} {line} ended on {date}: it gets no more security updates. Install it only if something needs exactly this version; otherwise choose a supported one.

steps.addRepo: Add the {repo} repository and check its signing key against the pinned fingerprint
steps.download: Download {name} {version} ({size}) from {source} and check it against the official checksum
steps.downloadLine: Download {name} {line} and check it against the official checksum
steps.packageSource: Download the packages from {source}, for this installation only
steps.packageTotal: ({count} package, {size} to download) | ({count} packages, {size} to download)

drawer.notInstalledText: Install it to manage its service and settings here.
drawer.notAvailable: {name} is not available on this system
drawer.unknownText: It is not in the catalog of this system.

service.intro: The systemd services of this version. The buttons act on all of them at once.
service.busy: A change to this software is running; the buttons wait until it ends.

stopText.nginx: nginx stops serving every site on this server until it is started again.
stopText.php: Every site that uses PHP {line} stops working until PHP-FPM is started again.
stopText.database: Sites and apps that use {name} lose their connection until it is started again.
stopText.other: {units} stop until they are started again.

extensions.intro: Extensions of PHP {line}. Installing or removing them reloads PHP-FPM {line}.
extensions.empty: No extensions are known for this version.
extensions.installTitle: Install {count} extension for PHP {line}? | Install {count} extensions for PHP {line}?
extensions.removeTitle: Remove {count} extension from PHP {line}? | Remove {count} extensions from PHP {line}?
extensions.installText: {names} will be installed, then PHP-FPM {line} reloads.
extensions.removeText: {names} will be removed, then PHP-FPM {line} reloads. Sites that use them may stop working.

configs.intro: Configuration files of this version. Opening or saving one may ask for your password: they can hold secrets.
configs.empty: This version has no editable configuration files.
configs.stepUp: Confirm your identity to open this file
configs.stepUpText: Configuration files can hold passwords: confirm your identity to open one.

steps.keep: Keep the current file as an earlier version
steps.restartDatabase: Restart {service}: its connections are briefly interrupted
steps.rollback: Put the previous file back if any of this fails

configs.reloadText: Your changes in the editor are discarded and the file is read as it is on the server now.

logs.label: Journal of {unit}
logs.empty: The journal has no entries for this service.
